ownerStatement: Release Kits 0.1.1-experimental. I waive the static cycle bound and the hardware qualification of this exact build for this version.
reason: Kits 0.1.1-experimental (#2066, by twwwy) adds SAVE KIT, RELOAD KIT and RENAME KIT to the shared Part Edit menu, on the plan the owner agreed on the agent board; the owner ported Kits 0.1.0 from Sam Banks' octabam KITS (MIT) and approves this update as its maintainer here. On an MKII, as trials on a development twin of base 0.8 (95adb64b), package c1cb63e5 ran alone and beside Pattern Sample Locks 0.1.9 and passed (TESTING.md). Not run: Keep, a power cycle, the flashed base 0.8, or an MKI. No static cycle count was made, and device:qualify did not run on the exact release package and base.
